messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: inference-service:quantized-96 pods reporting surge in 5xx and p95>4s in region-us-west. Paging oncall @sam :rotating_light:

sam: got it, pulling logs. hearing from the night shift? @maya you good?

maya: i'm here. we had a config tweak yesterday that bumped max-seq=4096 for some clients. seeing lots of KV-cache evictions and repeated `OOMKill` on container runtime.

sam: is this the quantized-96 flavor only?

maya: mostly quantized-96 and a few quantized-127 -> memory blowouts when seq>2k.

eric: correlating traces now. a partner beta (client-id=acme-beta) sent long streaming prompts; request size distribution jumped suddenly. seq median ~180 -> 2200.

jules: autoscaler policy for that pool is conservative (min=1, max=3). node quota in this region is exhausted for on-demand. we should failover traffic.

sam: re-routing high seq traffic to safety-pool (non-quantized) using routing rule: 
```
redwoodctl traffic mux --match "client=acme-beta and seq>1024" --to safety-pool
```

deploy-bot: Traffic mux applied by sam at 1936000020. ~55% of traffic matched.

sre-bot: Notifying infra team: Possible immediate capacity increase needed. @jules please advise.

jules: requesting emergency burst GKE nodes. Opening scale job:
```
kubectl apply -f burst-nodes.yaml --namespace=inference
```

maya: spun up 4 extra replicas of quantized-96. OOMs reduced. 5xx rate dropped ~60%.

sam: creating temp silence for the noisy alert rule so oncall can focus on mitigation (s-9001). keep latency alerts active.

maya: created silence s-9001 (expires 2h). Do not silence `inference_latency_p99`.

eric: propose followups: 
- increase autoscaler min to 2 for quantized-96 (owner: jules)
- widen 5xx alert window to 10m and threshold to 0.09 (owner: maya)
- add `group_by: model_variant,client_id` to reduce blast radius (owner: maya)
- new Grafana panel for request-context-length (owner: eric)

sam: agree. also need a short runbook entry "Long-request mitigation" with explicit routing + scale commands.

jules: I will also request quota increase with cloud team; filing cloud-ticket CT-312.

deploy-bot: maintenance window mw-1936000050 created by sam, duration 3h.

maya: verification: canary check against safety-pool shows p95 reduced from 4.4s -> 1.2s. good.

eric: running evals against safety-pool to confirm quality not degraded by fallback. `./evals/run --ids=prod-smoke --targets=safety-pool`

sam: tests in flight. ETA 18m.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Customer impact: increased latency and retries for some beta partners during window.

maya: drafting alert change PR. current expr:
```
alert: Inference5xxHigh
expr: rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m]) > 0.05
```
proposed:
```
expr: sum by (model_variant, client_id)(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[10m])) / sum by (model_variant, client_id)(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[10m])) > 0.09
for: 4m
```

jules: PR opened infra/alerts#488. assigning reviewers. i'll set autoscaler change in infra repo.

deploy-bot: PR merged and alert rules deployed by jules at 1936001200.

maya: removing silence s-9001 at 1936001300. leaving maintenance window open for verification.

sam: followup ticket INF-552 created: "Post-incident: autoscaler mins, alert grouping, seq-length metric, runbook". Owners: jules/maya/eric. due +3d.

eric: added Grafana panel prototype and linked test queries in INF-552. saved dashboard url: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/seqlen/seq-length

jules: autoscaler min replica set to 2 for quantized-96 at 1936001600. cloud quota request CT-312 submitted.

maya: confirmed p95 and 5xx stayed low for 90m after changes. no customer escalations. marking incident remedied.

sam: action checklist before close:
- ensure silence removed (maya) ✅
- maintenance window noted & extended if needed (sam) ✅
- INF-552 created and owners assigned (jules) ✅
- runbook snippet added (sam) in docs/runbooks/long-seq.md

incident-bot: Incident closed. Summary: mitigated via routing to safety-pool + burst scaling; tuned alerts and autoscaler mins; followups logged in INF-552.

maya: thanks everyone, retro notes incoming. I'll coordinate a synthetic load test to validate fixes next week.

eric: i'll own the retro doc and will capture metrics and timeline.

jules: good work. moving to cleanup.
